name: vllm_rotary_embedding
description: Faithfully extracted from KernelGenBench vLLM test_rotary_embedding.py. In-place RoPE: positions (seq_len,) int64 index into cos_sin_cache (cache_len,2,head_size); query/key (seq_len,num_heads,head_size) are rotated in place. Reference calls vLLM _custom_ops.rotary_embedding and returns the mutated (query, key) after cloning so the shared input is not double-rotated. gen_inputs builds in-range positions and a standard base-10000 RoPE cos_sin_cache exactly as the test does; query/key are plain randn. Migrated combos fix is_neox=True and key present (not None); the is_neox=False and key_is_none=True parametrize variants are not migrated. dtype in {fp16,bf16,fp32}. Default PyTree comparison validates query and key element-wise. Requires vLLM at eval time.
